column1: # ACTION TE (registered by p230, DISCHARGED here on limb 2 at 1) — "find where the 1EdTech
# Caliper and Open Badges reference code went, if anywhere."
# Limb 1 wanted a resolvable address for 2+ of the five withdrawn implementations (a renamed
# org, a successor repository, a package-registry artefact, or a fork carrying the standard's
# own copyright line). Limb 2 was 0-1 -> the reference implementations are genuinely withdrawn
# and every Caliper or Open Badges scope is a BUILD.
# RESULT: 1. The five SENSOR implementations are unrecoverable under BOTH org spellings. One
# package-registry artefact exists (npm `caliper`, MIT) and it is a third party's incubator,
# last published 2020-01-03, hosted on GitLab rather than GitHub. Limb 2 fires.
# What limb 2 did NOT anticipate and this pass adds: the SPEC repositories and a worked EXAMPLE
# app survive, under both org spellings, and Open Badges is NOT in the same state as Caliper —
# resolve. The withdrawal is of SENSORS, not of the standards tier.
# CHANNEL: raw.githubusercontent.com/<slug>/<ref>/README.md, refs tried HEAD, main, master,
# develop. Registry channel: registry.npmjs.org and pypi.org/pypi/<name>/json.
# DEFECT FOUND IN THIS PASS'S OWN INSTRUMENT, BEFORE PUBLISHING, AND IT MATTERS BEYOND THIS FILE:
# a README.md-keyed probe produces FALSE ABSENCES, because raw.githubusercontent.com is
# CASE-SENSITIVE. Citolab/qti-components - a row these shelves already carry - is 404 on
# README.md at every ref and 200 on readme.md, package.json and .gitignore. It is LIVE.
# So every absence below was re-tested on a FILENAME-AGNOSTIC oracle: `git ls-remote --symref
# https://github.com/<slug> HEAD` with GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0. A live public repository answers
# `ref: refs/heads/<branch>`; a withdrawn or private one makes git ask for a username, which is
# the absence signal. Controls on that oracle: HKUDS/DeepTutor -> refs/heads/main,
# absence is recovered). All ten probed absences below hold on BOTH channels.
